meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先自己生成网站设计图，仔细分析图片，再编写前端代码。它优先为每个区块生成独立大图，避免小图或裁剪旧图，并保持页面简洁、易读。
howto.when: 当你要求设计视觉重要的网站（如首页、落地页、作品集）时触发。Claude 会先出图再编码，而不是直接写代码。

say.text: 帮我设计一个高端 SaaS 产品的首页，包含英雄区和功能区块。
say.note: Claude 会先生成设计图，分析后实现前端代码。

say.text: 为我的作品集网站重新设计一个更现代的视觉风格。
say.note: Claude 会生成新的设计参考图，然后编码实现。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first generates its own design images, deeply analyzes them, then implements the frontend code. It prefers large, readable section-specific images over tiny compressed boards, avoids cropping old images, and keeps the hero clean and spacious.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a visually important website design (e.g., hero section, landing page, portfolio). Claude will generate images first before coding, rather than starting with freeform code.

say_en.text: Design a premium SaaS landing page with hero and feature sections.
say_en.note: Claude will generate design images first, then implement the frontend.

say_en.text: Redesign my portfolio site with a more modern visual style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate fresh design references, then code the site.
